motion.name: overshoot-settle
motion.purpose: State changes: card lift, pin selection, sidebar resize, dot fills.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Land capsule; the one action colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; min-height:44px; padding:0 1rem; border:none; border-radius:999px; background:var(--accent,#5a9e3d); color:var(--accent-contrast,#fff); font:inherit; font-weight:600; transition:filter .15s var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)), transform .15s var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Product Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.35rem; padding:3px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--land-wash-strong,#cbe2c2); color:var(--land-deep,#2f6b2b); font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: White lobe with petal corner; Land border + lift on hover.
components.html:
🍎
Obstgarten Maier
Offen bis 18:00 · 6 min zu Fuß
components.css: .ds-result-card { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.875rem; padding:0.75rem; background:var(--surface,#fff); border:1.5px solid rgba(44,46,42,.16); border-radius:22px 14px 14px 14px; box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(44,46,42,.08); transition:border-color .3s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.48,1)), transform .3s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.48,1)); } .ds-result-card:hover { border-color:var(--accent,#5a9e3d); transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(44,46,42,.16); } .ds-thumb { width:72px; height:72px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--land-wash,#e2eddb); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:2rem; flex:none; }

components.name: Map Pin
components.description: Petal-silhouette pin in kind colours; selected rotates and halos.
components.css: .ds-pin { width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50% 50% 50% 30%; background:var(--pin,#5a9e3d); color:var(--pin-ink,#fff); border:3px solid var(--water,#f5f1e4); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(44,46,42,.08); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; } .ds-pin.sel { width:52px; height:52px; transform:rotate(-4deg) translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pin,#5a9e3d) 22%, transparent), 0 10px 24px rgba(44,46,42,.16); }

components.name: Directions Bar
components.description: Full-width Land capsule closing the store panel.
components.css: .ds-directions { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--accent,#5a9e3d); color:var(--accent-contrast,#fff); font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; } .ds-directions:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); }

components.name: Section Card
components.description: Content lobe with quiet uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-section { padding:1rem; border:1px solid rgba(44,46,42,.16); border-radius:22px; background:var(--surface,#fff); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(44,46,42,.08); } .ds-label { margin:0 0 .75rem; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-secondary,#4b5346); }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: Segmented pill; active segment is a Land capsule.
components.css: .ds-lang { display:inline-flex; align-items:stretch; height:44px; padding:3px; border:1px solid rgba(44,46,42,.3); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface,#fff); } .ds-lang a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:2.75rem; padding:0 .75rem; border-radius:999px; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--text-secondary,#4b5346); text-decoration:none; } .ds-lang a.on { background:var(--accent,#5a9e3d); color:var(--accent-contrast,#fff); }

components.name: Store Hero
components.description: 180px cover photo under a green-ending scrim, white 800 name bottom-left.
components.css: .ds-hero { position:relative; height:180px; border-radius:22px 22px 0 0; background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,.18) 0%, transparent 35%, rgba(24,34,20,.72) 100%), linear-gradient(#7bb25c,#4c7d33); display:flex; align-items:flex-end; padding:16px; } .ds-hero h2 { margin:0; color:#fff; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.04em; font-size:1.75rem; }

narrative.northStar: Der Gartenplan — the zoo & gardens guide map
narrative.overview: The 2026 facelift replaced the Farm Shop Counter world with a guide-map world: the app reads like the folded map you get at a garden's entrance. Cream is the water the interface floats on; every panel, card, and chip is a lobe of land rising from it — white or green, flat, unmodulated, with one petal corner that marks it as part of the guide rather than a box. One grotesque (the system sans, never a web font) carries everything in two voices: 800-weight short-lead display for headings, regular for body. Colour does real jobs only: the land greens mean brand and action, and the four capsule colours are identities — sun (farm shop), pond (vending machine), coral (market), lilac (season-off) — never decoration. Motion is the guide's overshoot settle: everything that moves takes 0.4s, overshoots, and settles.
keyCharacteristics: Cream water ground; white lobe cards with one petal corner
Guide green (land) for brand, pins, primary actions; darker land-deep for text accents
Four capsule colour identities: sun/pond/coral/lilac, each with its own ink
One grotesque, 800/-0.03em display, 750 card titles; label voice is spaced uppercase
Petal-silhouette pins and clusters; petal brand mark
Overshoot settle easing on everything that moves; reduced-motion flattens it

rules.name: The Capsule Rule
rules.body: The four capsule colours are identities, not decoration: sun = farm shop, pond = vending machine, coral = market, lilac = season-off. A colour leaves its capsule only to carry its own meaning.

rules.name: The Water Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats without being a lobe: content sits on white (or green) cards with at least one petal corner, never directly on the water.

rules.name: The Two-Green Rule
rules.body: Land decorates; Land Deep speaks. Text on light grounds is always Land Deep, never Land.

rules.name: The Zero-Download Rule
rules.body: Web fonts are never loaded; any font file or font CDN proposal is rejected — it would also leak every visitor's IP.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Region names are 12px uppercase spaced labels; the heavy display voice is reserved for what a visitor reads aloud.

rules.name: The Lifted-Leaf Rule
rules.body: Shadows lift something off the water: dropdowns, tooltips, dialogs, the selected pin. Content at rest never earns one; hover may raise a card as the state's response.

rules.name: The Night-Ground Rule
rules.body: Dark mode re-derives the world (deep green-black water, warmed capsules) rather than dimming the light palette.

dos: Do use app tokens for every colour — any literal breaks dark mode silently.
Do keep the petal corner on lobes: cards, sections, admin rows, pins, clusters, brand mark share the one silhouette.
Do ride the overshoot curve (--ease 0.3–0.4s) for state changes.
Do preserve 44px touch targets (40px on phones).
Do keep the map itself in guide-map colours: pins and clusters carry the palette; the basemap stays real-world.
Do keep German and English visually identical.
donts: Don't add web fonts, font CDNs, or external asset hosts.
Don't paint literal hex/rgba in components; tokens are the single source of truth.
Don't decorate with the capsule colours: each of sun/pond/coral/lilac means exactly one thing; Critical stays reserved for state.
Don't use grey-on-colour for secondary text on tinted grounds — tint it from the surface hue.
Don't introduce a second accent or a serif display.
Don't ship flat-color without the lobes: grey+accent is the category default, not this world.
